description: Adds named literal validation commands to governed tasks and an execution wrapper that runs only those commands, preserving the task-declared output bound and exit-status handling while recording the result in project-local execution evidence. Budgeted diagnostics, captures, and context expansions now require a durable evidence-gap record; captures additionally name their acceptance criterion and artifact. Completion handoffs now expose budget use explicitly, so a reviewer can reject a report that silently omits diagnostic, capture, or context-expansion consumption.
delta: tasks/TASK_BLUEPRINT.md changes its Validation section from an unstructured command placeholder to named literal commands, names `meridian execution validate <TASK-ID> <validation-id> --project .` as the required runner, and requires `meridian execution evidence` before a budgeted diagnostic, capture, or context expansion. docs/COMPLETION_REPORT_TEMPLATE.md adds a Budget usage field. The framework CLI adds execution preflight, validation execution, durable validation-result recording, evidence-gap/capture provenance recording, and completion-handoff checks.
verification: tasks/TASK_BLUEPRINT.md carries capability=task-blueprint v7 and declares named literal validation commands
meridian execution validate runs only a task-declared validation ID and records its exit status
meridian execution evidence requires an evidence gap and captures additionally record criterion and artifact
meridian execution handoff-check rejects a report missing Budget usage
